review_type: Independent read-only bounded Controls MasterDetail pure-state/layout review
decision: Cleared for bounded MD-1 draw-state purity and MD-3 layout/draw agreement in termrock-controls::MasterDetail. No new actionable source finding in this scope. MD-2 separate facade mechanics duplication remains unresolved; no full block, facade, app or product acceptance.

changes: drawer_open and return_focus Cell values replaced by ordinary private bool/Option fields.
Focus reconciliation moved to MasterDetail::update before routing current master/detail bindings; draw no longer changes state via shared reference.
layout now depends solely on area, configuration and immutable state; draw invokes that exact public layout result, including split, master/summary and drawer modes.
SplitPane remains split/seam geometry and input owner. Rendering reports framework layout and bindings but does not run domain/input handlers.
source_review.compatibility: Existing public constructors/builders/update/layout/draw/state accessors unchanged. Existing defaults, focus policies and bindings retained. State fields remain private; default/clone/debug/equality continue to cover their actual values. No new unsafe, allocation ownership or cross-thread mechanism introduced.
source_review.tests_review: Author adds real Buttons purity test and updates one former draw-mutation expectation to require update reconciliation. It does not waive draw purity or delete scenario coverage. All controls native tests pass independently.

original_regression.before_result: RED: draw changes caller drawer_open false->true through Cell
original_regression.note: Original public probe was reused unchanged; no expected-state weakening.

cases: Real focused TextInput and Button across actual120x30->99x24->101x25 Harness resize: pure mode/layout equals delivered draw layout, actual controls fit assigned pane, hidden master unregisters in drawer, cursor fits visible editor
After narrow resize, pointer hits actual TEXT region, inserts into original draft, keyboard continues after wide resize, Enter commits exact acb value
Zero/narrow/adjacent breakpoint regions remain within root bounds; repeated drawing preserves caller MasterDetailState
Public explicit drawer open from actual Button activation before component update survives and focuses detail

explicit_open_compatibility.before_and_after: PASS with byte-identical final open_order.rs and shared public testing delivery helper; no opener-ordering defect established.

fixture_corrections_and_preservation: Initial additional region fixture incorrectly expected intrinsic Button/TextInput hit regions to equal entire allocated panes. Corrected to assert pure layout equals delivered draw layout and actual control/cursor containment, while preserving exact breakpoint/mode and functional pointer/edit assertions. Original frozen regression source was never changed.

Initial exploratory opener fixtures ignored Runtime::handle PendingInput, so intended update/activation never occurred. Tick and activation guards proved these failures were fixture readiness errors. Final byte-identical opener probe uses existing public runtime::stub::deliver; passes before and after. Invalid failures are preserved in raw logs and not reported as product defects.

Harness backend resize can catch/retry AreaChanged during test publication. Settled real hit/cursor and next-input assertions pass; this does not independently clear all production terminal resize scheduling or modes.

md2_remaining.status: Open. It still has separate responsive composition state/behavior; root termrock::MasterDetail/State reexports this block at lib.rs:87, while this repair targets controls::MasterDetail. This review does not conflate or approve both implementations.
md2_remaining.required: Separate canonical owner/composition adaptation and real facade/application consumers, with compatibility and paired product checks.

limits: Native pointer/seam/modal/focus tests passing are scoped to controls suite; no complete new cross-profile matrix, Unicode editor suite or all drag/cancellation scenarios claimed.
No frozen real-CLI tuiscotti paired comparison, exact cell/frame parity or all four application verification executed.
No unrelated merge-parent Forms/runtime/theme changes reviewed as part of this MasterDetail delta.
No full workspace gate or facade MasterDetail acceptance.
